prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: And... our flight was cancelled. Well done
Delta: Hi. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Please DM your confirmation number. I'll see what I can do to help.  *TJH https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: That time when  cancelled my flight preemptively, twice, and I've been on hold for TWO HOURS
Delta: Oh no, Adam. That's not what we want to hear. Can you please share your confirmation number via DM?  *AOS

Customer: well??? Time to get it together - this is about DUCT TAPE!
Delta: I would have to ask for your flight number to provide you with an update, Diana. *AST

Customer: Hey  what time does your luggage drop open at CVG?
Delta: Please, bear with me. *AMV

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: delay_cancellation):
"""flight dep time adjusted 5 times then cancelled while flight after departs on time? How does bag get sent if flight cancelled? Awful"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the inconvenience. Please DM us your confirmation number so we can look into your bag’s routing and help you further.
